# Navimower Map Card 0.3.1-beta4

0.3.1-beta4 fixes the beta3 title-row regression and simplifies Notifications into one scrollable list that is ready for a larger retained notification history from the Navimower integration.

## Title/header fix

- Fix the configured card title disappearing after the beta3 two-row header change.
- The stable core writes `display:flex` inline on the header; beta4 now reasserts the intended two-row layout after each shell render.
- `show_title` remains available and defaults to `true`.
- History, Notifications and Schedule remain on the separate wrapping action row.

## Scrollable Notifications

- Remove Previous/Next pagination from the Notifications dialog.
- Show retained notifications in one vertically scrollable list, using mouse-wheel/trackpad scrolling on desktop and touch scrolling on mobile.
- Keep the compact timestamp + title layout; clicking a title expands its content and marks an unread item read.
- Keep per-message **Mark as read**, **Mark all as read**, and optional mark-all-read when opening.
- Add `notification_count`, labelled **Notifications to show**, with range 1–10 and default 5.
- Remove `notification_page_size` from the current beta4 config and visual editor; it is not used as a fallback.
- The unread bell state still considers the full retained `Latest notification.recent` set, even when the user chooses to display fewer items.

## Integration preparation

The card can consume up to 10 retained notifications without another paging change. A following Navimower integration beta can therefore raise its `recent` retention from 5 to 10 and the card will expose the selected number through `notification_count`.

## Cache-safe beta asset

HACS loads `navimower-map-card-0.3.1-b4.js`. Earlier betas retain their own loader URLs and stable 0.3.1 remains reserved for `navimower-map-card-0.3.1.js`.
